chunks: Surely Ar-Rahman will show love for those who believe and do the right.
ai.seo_question: Who does Allah promise to love according to Surah Maryam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as the culmination of the believer's spiritual journey, where divine love (Wudd) is not merely an emotion but a state of being cherished by Allah due to the synergy of belief (Iman) and action (Amal). It underscores the principle that true faith must manifest in righteous deeds to attract the specific affection of the Merciful, a concept central to the Shia understanding of the relationship between the believer and the Divine. This reciprocal love serves as a spiritual reward that distinguishes the sincere from the merely nominal believers.
